core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fursan corresponds to the Arabic form فرسان (Arabic root ف ر س (f-r-s); فُرسان (fursān) plural of فارس (fāris)). Its core sense is riders, horsemen. Fursan (فُرسان) is the Arabic plural of فارس (fāris) 'knight, horseman' — 'riders, horsemen, cavaliers'. It is used as a male given name. The source gloss 'riders of the steeds' is a poetic expansion of 'horsemen'.
